ydqReeTV_vk.title: Evo-Devo (Despacito Biology Parody) | A Capella Science
ydqReeTV_vk.summary: A Capella Science parody of Despacito that sings through evolutionary developmental biology, explaining how a single cell becomes a body, including body-axis genes and dormant snake leg DNA. It runs about four minutes.
ydqReeTV_vk.why: HN recommends it as an entertaining four-minute introduction to evo-devo that works even for people who dislike the original song.

quote.text: A TL;DR in four minutes by A Capella Science

TVwKjGbz60k.title: Slavoj Žižek on "They Live" (The Pervert's Guide to Ideology)
TVwKjGbz60k.summary: A short excerpt from The Pervert's Guide to Ideology in which Slavoj Zizek analyzes John Carpenter's They Live. He uses the film's fight scene and sunglasses to explain how ideology works.
TVwKjGbz60k.why: HN cites it as a concise, memorable explanation of ideology, often in threads about advertising, propaganda or AI-shaped narratives.

quote.text: it finally clicked after hearing Zizek talk about it.

hz_mMLhUinw.title: The Superheterodyne Radio: No really, that's its name
hz_mMLhUinw.summary: Technology Connections explains why the superheterodyne radio has its name and how mixing frequencies lets it tune stations well. It walks through the underlying wave phenomena and algebra and why the design solved a hard tuning problem.
hz_mMLhUinw.why: HN people use it as the accessible go-to explainer for the superhet trick whenever radios or signal processing come up.

quote.text: This video is a great explainer (and I also highly recommend every other video on the channel)

qPKj0YnKANw.title: Hawking Radiation
qPKj0YnKANw.summary: PBS Space Time explains Stephen Hawking's prediction of Hawking radiation and how black holes can emit radiation and slowly evaporate. It goes beyond the common particle-antiparticle analogy.
qPKj0YnKANw.why: Recommended as an accessible and correct explanation of Hawking radiation for non-physicists.

quote.text: explains it really well while keeping it accessible for non-physicists

BTlUyS-T-_4.title: The REAL reason behind the housing crisis
BTlUyS-T-_4.summary: Gary's Economics argues that the UK housing crisis stems from wealth inequality, treating housing as an asset like shares that rich people bid up. He contends that simply building more housing won't fix affordability.
BTlUyS-T-_4.why: HN commenters share it as a counterargument to the YIMBY build-more-housing view, linking wealth concentration to asset prices.

quote.text: It feels to me like a good faith counterargument to the YIMBY build more housing line of thought, so might be an interesting perspective

q9Golcxjpi8.title: Renting vs Buying a Home: How to Decide
q9Golcxjpi8.summary: Ben Felix explains how to decide between renting and buying a home, weighing financial and non-financial factors. He argues that renting is often as good or better than owning, both financially and for well-being.
q9Golcxjpi8.why: Cited in housing threads for his rule-of-thumb rent-versus-buy analysis and the view that it is often a financial wash.

quote.text: I find his ideas on renting vs. buying to be quite sound.

xFKFoGiGlXQ.title: Finding the BEST sine function for Nintendo 64
xFKFoGiGlXQ.summary: Kaze Emanuar searches for the best sine approximation for the Nintendo 64, comparing the lookup tables in Mario 64 and Ocarina of Time with polynomial alternatives. It walks through numerics and 3rd, 4th and 5th order approximations.
xFKFoGiGlXQ.why: Cited in discussions of sine implementations and whether lookup tables beat computation on memory-bound hardware.

quote.text: This guy puts a lot of work into figuring out if there is a faster way to do trig calcs on the N64

BcyYyyaPz84.title: GHOST CITY - Inside the Chinese Housing Bubble
BcyYyyaPz84.summary: ADVChina tours Chinese ghost cities and discusses the housing bubble, with speculative buyers purchasing empty apartments as investments.
BcyYyyaPz84.why: Linked in threads on China's property glut as visual evidence of empty, investment-driven housing, later seen as foreshadowing Evergrande.

Sw_Ze9zIafM.title: End of Days Bolognese
Sw_Ze9zIafM.summary: A short, sweary cooking video in which Nat makes a quick bolognese using simple pantry ingredients. It is part of his isolation-era cooking series.
Sw_Ze9zIafM.why: Mentioned as an example of a straightforward, no-nonsense recipe channel that happens to be profane.

quote.text: Nat's What I Reckon has some great recipes that are straightforward.

Ug8NH67_EfE.title: Rick Reacts to Lightning (Again) and brings up a previously undiscussed flaw
Ug8NH67_EfE.summary: Rick Falkvinge responds to viewer feedback on his earlier Lightning Network video and raises a flaw he says was not previously discussed. The main thread is the network's unsolved routing problem.
Ug8NH67_EfE.why: HN commenters cite it, with a pointer to the section from about 10:00, when arguing that Lightning has no solved routing algorithm; most mentions are critical of Lightning.

quote.text: Key bit from 10:00 on, though the rest is well worth your time

b9ifQvQCO7Y.title: Longhorn concept
b9ifQvQCO7Y.summary: A concept video from 2003 showing an early vision of Windows Longhorn's interface, before it shipped as Vista.
b9ifQvQCO7Y.why: Cited to contrast Microsoft's ambitious Longhorn vision with the Vista that actually shipped.

p45T7U5oi9Q.title: The Dial Comes To Town
p45T7U5oi9Q.summary: A 1940 Bell Telephone educational short teaching customers how to use their new dial phones and why the change was happening. It is a period piece about rolling out a new technology to ordinary people.
p45T7U5oi9Q.why: Cited as a charming example of the effort once made to teach the public a new technology, in threads about phones and teaching seniors.

quote.text: here is a 1940 educational movie by Bell Telephone they made to teach customers about this new technology

tt7gP_IW-1w.title: A$AP Mob - Yamborghini High (Official Video) ft. Juicy J
tt7gP_IW-1w.summary: The official music video for A$AP Mob's Yamborghini High featuring Juicy J, known for heavy datamoshing and glitch effects with hue shifting.
tt7gP_IW-1w.why: Cited as a standout example of datamoshing and codec-corruption aesthetics in threads on video compression and glitch art.

quote.text: The Yamborghini High music video from 2016 did some really cool stuff with datamoshing and hue shifting

6kg4vVYKc90.title: chernobyl 2013: radioactive ant bites & 115 mSv/h of pure gamma radiation
6kg4vVYKc90.summary: A YouTuber explores the Chernobyl zone in 2013, takes a gamma spectrum of a hot reactor fuel fragment, and jokes about a radioactive ant bite. It is a hands-on amateur look at radiation in the exclusion zone.
6kg4vVYKc90.why: Cited as an example of Chernobyl YouTuber content and of casual handling of radioactive material.

quote.text: This lady is bitten by a radioactive ant, live on camera.... near Chernobyl.

Km5XQxRrQvw.title: Jian Yang's New Pied Piper - Silicon Valley

Km5XQxRrQvw.why: Used as a joke in threads about app clones and the TikTok ban.

iIiAAhUeR6Y.title: Choice, happiness and spaghetti sauce | Malcolm Gladwell
iIiAAhUeR6Y.summary: Malcolm Gladwell's TED talk on how Howard Moskowitz found that there is no single perfect spaghetti sauce. He draws a larger point about choice, preference and happiness.
iIiAAhUeR6Y.why: Cited to argue that people do not know what they want and that markets should be segmented.

quote.text: People have no idea what they want or need, or even what they like.
